summary: Request: Temporary network sudo + loaner workstation for cross-team research secondment
description:
Issue summary:
Requester (internal): Engineering manager requests time-limited network sudo on two internal jump hosts and a loaner workstation for an engineer on a 2-week cross-team research secondment. The engineer is from the research org and will need elevated network tooling for debugging dataset syncs and access to internal GPU lab staging.

Impact:
- Engineer needs elevated access to run network traces and restart a handful of internal services on staging jump hosts; without sudo the research work is blocked.
- Timeline: start 2026-03-02, end 2026-03-16.

Background/context:
- This is a temporary secondment (research -> infra) approved by manager and HR. HR has provided sign-off email included as attachment. The engineer will use a loaner managed workstation; their corporate laptop is being reimaged and unavailable until 2026-03-03.

Requested items:
1) Grant time-limited sudo on jump-staging-1 and jump-staging-2 to group research-secondment-INT-112358 for the period 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-16.
2) Ship a loaner M1/M2 developer workstation (company asset) pre-enrolled in MDM and MFA.
3) Create a time-limited KMS decrypt-only grant for specific dataset bucket for the same period; logs must be auditable.
4) Provide VPN split-tunnel access to staging region.

Attachments referenced:
- HR sign-off (email)
- Manager approval slack thread #people-research (link in comments)

Acceptance criteria:
- sudo grant is auditable and expires automatically on 2026-03-16 23:59 UTC.
- Loaner device delivered to the shipping address and enrolled in MDM with company policies applied.
- KMS grant scoped to the minimal dataset key and expires same day as sudo.
- Confirmed ability to run traceroute, tcpdump (non-root limitations documented) and restart service A on jump hosts during a validation window.
comments: 2026-03-01 10:12 - Maya Chen (reporter): Adding HR sign-off and manager approval. Manager (A. Singh) has pinged #people-research to confirm secondment. Requested expedited processing due to short timeline.

2026-03-01 13:05 - Noah Patel (assignee): Thanks, I will start inventory check for loaner devices and validate whether jump hosts are managed by ssh-sudo-group or require local ACL changes. Tentatively assigning to SRE for sudo flow design.

2026-03-01 16:40 - Priya Rao (SRE): Confirmed jump-staging hosts are managed via LDAP groups backed by Okta SCIM. We do not have an existing 'research-secondment' ephemeral group. Recommend creating an Okta JIT rule that provisions membership for 2 weeks; will require IAM approval for group creation. Need final shipping address for loaner and device model preference.

2026-03-02 09:22 - A. Singh (manager): Shipping address sent via secure form. Prefers M2 16GB if available. Confirm HR onboarding record attached. Please expedite KMS grant as dataset access is time-sensitive.

2026-03-03 11:18 - Noah Patel: Inventory check shows one M2 16GB available in us-west warehouse. Submitted asset release ticket to inventory INT-421785 (asset-release) and escalated shipping to express. Okta JIT rule created in staging; pending policy review and approval by IAM.
investigation_notes:
2026-03-02: IAM review by Priya/SRE. Findings: (1) Current sudo flow requires LDAP group membership; Okta SCIM can sync a group but group lifecycle must be automated to guarantee expiry. (2) KMS policies support time-limited grants via IAM role assumption; recommended approach is to create a short-lived role with decrypt-only permissions restricted to the dataset prefix. (3) VPN split-tunnel profile exists for 'staging-research' but user is not in that group.
Actions taken so far: created staging Okta group 'research-secondment-INT-112358' (staging only) to validate flows; tested sudo commands via group membership; confirmed MDM enrollment procedure for loaner device and MDM token provisioning works. Identified requirement for an IAM ticket to create production-scoped Okta provisioning rule and a KMS role for timed grants.
Open questions: need confirmation on who approves production Okta group creation and KMS role (security/infra approvers).
planned_resolution:
Planned steps: (1) Security/IAM to approve ephemeral Okta group provisioning for 2026-03-02 to 2026-03-16. (2) Create a JIT rule that automatically removes membership on expiry. (3) Provision temporary KMS role with decrypt-only access limited to dataset-2026/research-secondment and attach CloudTrail logging. (4) Ship M2 loaner enrolled with MDM; provide user credentials and enforce MFA. (5) Conduct a 30-min validation session with engineer to confirm sudo and dataset access.
Expected completion: 2026-03-03 (suspenders: hardware shipped) to 2026-03-04 (access fully provisioned).
resolution: In progress: Okta JIT rule approved by IAM on 2026-03-03. Inventory released and loaner device shipped same day (tracking #1Z999). MDM enrollment completed remotely; device shows as managed in Intune. KMS role creation request filed with Security (SEC-2026-77) and awaiting final approval; until KMS grant is created data access is blocked. Follow-up: Security to confirm KMS grant schedule and audit logging.
follow_up_actions:
- Security to finalize SEC-2026-77 and apply time-limited KMS role by 2026-03-04.
- SRE to run validation with engineer and document allowed sudo commands to minimize blast radius.
- Inventory to record loaner asset checkout under employee ID and update asset tag in internal inventory.
- Post-secondment: create deprovision ticket to remove group membership and reclaim loaner device (automated by JIT expiry but verify return).
